## Cambodia

```{r Cambodia read data}
Cambodia_Battery_Roster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Battery Roster.dta")
Cambodia_HHRoster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/HHRoster.dta")
Cambodia_Main_Dataset <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Main Dataset.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_F <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster F.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_G <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster G.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_H <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster H.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_I <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster I.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_N <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster N.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_Q <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster Q.dta")
Cambodia_Roster_R <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Roster R.dta")
Cambodia_Solar_Roster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Solar Roster.dta")
Cambodia_Village_Fuel_Roster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Village_Fuel Roster.dta")
Cambodia_Village_Infrastructure_Roster <- 
  read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Village_Infrastructure Roster.dta")
Cambodia_Village_Main_Dataset <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Village_Main Dataset.dta")
```
